title: How many school shootings have there been in the US in 2025?
summary: Depending on the database used, there were between 8 and 146 incidents of gun violence at schools across the US in 2025.

title: ‘Massive’ Russian attack on Ukraine’s Kyiv kills at least 15, wounds dozens
summary: Ukrainian authorities say four children were among those killed in Russian attack that struck multiple areas of Kyiv.
